why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: Open app.synthra.org and sign in with X or a wallet. Signing in with a wallet only signs a message.
Under Portfolio, open Rewards and referrals and connect your X account.

Fund the account on mainnet. Arc uses USDC to pay for gas. Warning Points come only from real money at risk. Synthra's terms say: "You may lose some or all of your digital assets. Never invest more than you can afford to lose."
Add liquidity to a Synthra pool on Arc or Robinhood Chain and keep the position in range. Only in-range liquidity earns the largest share of points.
Swap or trade perps if you want the volume share. Perps need a Hyperliquid account you fund yourself, with a 5 USDC minimum.
Share your referral code from the rewards page if you want referral points.
